messages:
ash: quick sync: console wants identity shown on route bars. current metrics use raw key ids in three places. we need a low-cardinality approach before rollout.
ravi: big yes. proposal: emit `identity_hash` + `identity_type` in metrics, push full mapping events to logstore. console does batched lookup on hover/click.
tess: note on routing: some rules depend on project-owner. if key has no project, we should fall back to org then billing. need to document precedence.
ravi: agree. also retention: metrics with hash 90d, aggregated 365d, logstore mapping 30d by default. customers can request exports for compliance.
ash: spelling correction: ash :) also add auth_method enum (api_key, sa, oauth) so filters work without hash joins.
ops-bot: deploy queued: telemetry/identity-schema @staging (PR #5102) tests passed
ash: final action items: ravi PR for schema + sample payload, tess docs for precedence & retention, ash implement console lookup + 24h canary. run staggered rollout afterwards.
ravi: sample metric we'll include in PR: `{"metric":"redwood.auth.request","labels":{"route":"/v1/complete","result":"200","identity_hash":"cafe12","identity_type":"sa","auth_method":"sa"},"value":1}`
tess: don't include full identity in alerts (PII). alerts should reference hash only.
ash: thanks all, filing follow-up ticket TELEM-901 and marking resolved :thumbsup:
